text: Congrats SpaceX team! — quoting @SpaceX: Q3 2026 highlights: Delivered revenue of $14.6 billion, up 161% year-over-year. Successfully launched our first revenue-generating Starship mission, delivering 26 Starlink V3 satellites
zh: 马斯克：祝贺 SpaceX 团队！（转引 SpaceX 2026 年三季度要点：营收 146 亿美元，同比增 161%；星舰首次执行商业任务，送入 26 颗星链 V3 卫星）

text: Treasury congratulates @TheJusticeDept on launching the Fraud Whistleblower Incentive Program and is proud to commit $25 million to support it.
zh: 美国财政部：祝贺司法部推出欺诈举报人激励计划，财政部承诺拨款 2500 万美元支持。

text: As crazy as this sounds, $1T in SpaceX revenue in 2028 is no longer impossible
zh: 马斯克：听起来很疯狂，但 SpaceX 在 2028 年实现 1 万亿美元营收已不再是不可能。

text: I am very grateful Aleksander accepted our request to come take this on; the safety and security challenges in front of us as we confront superintelligence are immense.
zh: 奥特曼：感谢 Aleksander 接受邀请回归 OpenAI 负责安全工作，面对超级智能，我们的安全挑战极其巨大。

text: Our Q3 2026 earnings report is now public. The live webcast with @ElonMusk, @Gwynne_Shotwell, and @BretWJ will begin in 30 minutes
zh: SpaceX：2026 年第三季度财报已发布，马斯克、肖特维尔等将进行财报直播。

text: We’ve acquired Orchestra Bio, a platform that helps biopharma teams coordinate the complex process of drug development.
zh: OpenAI：已收购生物医药协作平台 Orchestra Bio，将结合其生命科学 AI 工具 Rosalind 加速药物研发。

text: Preview of two upcoming spacewalks set for Oct. 29 and Nov. 5 to finish installing solar arrays.
zh: NASA：空间站将于 10 月 29 日和 11 月 5 日进行两次太空行走，完成太阳能电池阵安装。

text: “Lack of electricity” is an oversimplification. Everything is hard about bringing massive compute online at extremely high speed. If there was twice as much time, this would be relatively easy, but there is not. — quoting @: Former $GOOGL employee on why data center capacity and electricity are the real bottlenecks
zh: 马斯克：说算力瓶颈是“缺电”太简单化了，极速上线海量算力的每个环节都难；时间若多一倍会相对容易，但没有这个时间。

text: Falcon 9 launches the Bandwagon-5 rideshare mission to orbit from Florida
zh: SpaceX：猎鹰 9 号从佛罗里达发射 Bandwagon-5 拼车任务入轨，一级回收成功。

text: The value of Terafab’s output will place it in the top 20 of country GDP in a single building — quoting: Terafab is now talking to almost every Korean chip supplier
zh: 马斯克：Terafab 芯片厂单栋楼的产值将可排进全球国家 GDP 前 20（引述：Terafab 正与几乎所有韩国芯片供应商洽谈）。

text: New on our Science Blog: designing protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins. Claude has made an early step toward finding new treatments.
zh: Anthropic：Claude 协助设计针对蝎毒神经毒素的蛋白结合剂，为新疗法迈出早期一步。

text: Tomorrow, Jensen takes the stage at #NVIDIAGTC Berlin.
zh: 英伟达：黄仁勋明天将在 GTC 柏林大会登台演讲，主题是欧洲 AI 建设。

text: Welcome to the Artemis Accords, Uzbekistan. Uzbekistan has joined 76 other nations.
zh: NASA：乌兹别克斯坦加入《阿尔忒弥斯协定》，签署国增至 77 个。

text: THE TRUMP EFFECT. American manufacturing is back! — quoting: Apple commits up to $100 million for US titanium in domestic manufacturing push
zh: 白宫：美国制造业回来了！（引述：苹果承诺投入至多 1 亿美元采购美国本土钛材，推动国内制造）

text: New and expanded partnerships with Perryman Company and Qnity Electronics for American manufacturing!
zh: 库克：苹果与 Perryman、Qnity Electronics 新建和扩大合作，推进美国本土制造。

text: Galileo Second Generation is taking shape. A new signal generation module, designed to be reprogrammed in orbit.
zh: 欧洲航天局：第二代伽利略导航系统成形，新信号生成模块可在轨重新编程。

text: Great to meet with the @saintgobain team in Paris today and learn how they’re using Microsoft Discovery to accelerate new construction materials.
zh: 纳德拉：在巴黎会见圣戈班团队，了解其用 Microsoft Discovery 加速研发高效建材。

text: T-45 minutes until today's Falcon 9 launch of the Bandwagon-5 rideshare mission from pad 40 in Florida. Liftoff is targeted for 7:04 a.m. ET, and weather is 95% favorable
zh: SpaceX：猎鹰9号将于美东时间7:04（北京时间19:04）从佛罗里达40号工位发射Bandwagon-5拼车任务，倒计时45分钟，天气95%适宜。

text: Today in Paris, we announced new capabilities across Microsoft Sovereign Cloud, expanding choice and control for organizations running their most sensitive workloads across public and private cloud, and our growing partner ecosystem.
zh: 纳德拉：今日在巴黎宣布微软主权云新能力，扩大敏感工作负载在公有云、私有云及合作伙伴生态中的选择与控制。

text:
Two important changes to timeline recommendations:

- New AI/SI ranking model that predicts probable time spent much better

- Retrieval model trained to surface posts people read all the way through

User active seconds is growing exponentially and hitting all-time highs almost
zh: 马斯克：X时间线推荐两项重要调整——新的AI排序模型能更准地预测停留时长；检索模型优先推送被完整读完的帖子。用户活跃时长呈指数增长，几乎天天创新高。

text: Protecting America's Farmers. — quoting @USDA: Today, @POTUS and @SecRollins announced the Harvest Fuel Relief Program — making $8 BILLION available for one-time payments to farmers facing higher costs and market disruptions.
zh: 白宫：保护美国农民。（转引美国农业部：特朗普与农业部长罗林斯宣布“收获燃料救济计划”，拿出80亿美元向面临成本上升和市场扰动的农民一次性发放补贴。）

text: Have to give the EU regulators credit where it’s due for making all Apple products use USB-C
zh: 马斯克：该给欧盟监管者记一功——是他们让所有苹果产品都用上了USB-C。

text:
Our latest model advances bring stronger capabilities for building and migrating software in low-resource programming languages such as COBOL, Fortran, and Visual Basic.

These languages power software that banks, governments, and businesses depend on. Progress here means
zh: OpenAI：最新模型在COBOL、Fortran、Visual Basic等小众编程语言上的开发与迁移能力更强，这些语言支撑着银行、政府和企业依赖的系统。

text: Today, Treasury announced that @FinCENnews has identified approximately $270 million in suspicious financial activity potentially linked to fraud against federal student aid programs. FinCEN has referred these findings to federal investigators to pursue potential fraud schemes
zh: 美国财政部：金融犯罪执法网络（FinCEN）发现约2.7亿美元可疑资金活动，可能涉及联邦学生资助项目欺诈，已移交联邦调查人员追查。

text:
🚨 TEXAS!

Early Voting, in-person, opened in the Great State of Texas TODAY, October 19th. If you have a mail-in ballot, return it immediately and, if not, GO VOTE at the Polls RIGHT NOW, and get everyone you know to VOTE FOR THE REPUBLICAN IN EVERY RACE, UP AND DOWN THE BALLOT!
zh: 特朗普：得州中期选举现场提前投票于10月19日开启，呼吁选民立即投票，在各级选举中支持共和党候选人。

text: A BIG THANK YOU to our legendary friend, @ElonMusk, for his incredible generosity in giving SpaceX Stock to millions of American children through TRUMP ACCOUNTS! This is exactly what was envisioned when we created TRUMP ACCOUNTS — Bringing together the GREAT PRIVATE SECTOR, Elon
zh: 特朗普：非常感谢传奇朋友马斯克慷慨地通过“特朗普账户”向数百万美国儿童赠送SpaceX股票！这正是设立特朗普账户的初衷——把伟大的私营部门汇聚起来……

text: The SEC's Office of Data Standards and Innovation in the Division of Economic and Risk Analysis is hosting a roundtable, Machine-Understandable Data In the Age of Super Intelligence, on Monday November 9, 2026.
zh: 美国SEC：经济与风险分析部数据标准与创新办公室将于11月9日举办圆桌会议，主题为“超级智能时代的机器可理解数据”。

text: President Donald J. Trump’s @ONDCP has overseen a MASSIVE decrease in drug overdose deaths since such deaths peaked under the Biden Administration, saving thousands of American lives. 🇺🇸
zh: 白宫：在特朗普政府国家药物管制政策办公室主导下，药物过量死亡人数较拜登时期峰值大幅下降，挽救了数千人的生命。

text:
Germany knows how to build, and now it’s bringing that expertise to industrial AI. 🇩🇪

Tonight in Berlin, @JensenHuang and Chancellor @_FriedrichMerz discussed combining German engineering with NVIDIA AI to advance manufacturing and automotive.

We’re also backing Germany’s
zh: 英伟达：黄仁勋与德国总理默茨在柏林探讨将德国工程能力与英伟达AI结合，推动制造业和汽车业发展；英伟达同时加大对德国的支持。

text: NVIDIA and @fzj_jsc ran a record 104-qubit simulation of fault-tolerant quantum computing on JUPITER, Europe’s biggest supercomputer, so researchers can refine designs before building hardware, shortening the path to viable quantum computers.
zh: 英伟达与于利希超算中心在欧洲最大超算JUPITER上完成创纪录的104量子比特容错量子计算模拟，可在造硬件前优化设计，缩短实用量子计算机的研发路径。

text: Join #FederalReserveEducation on Tuesday, October 20, as we celebrate #EconEdMonth with our webinar, Teaching Monetary Policy: From the Fed’s Origins to Today’s Tools.
zh: 美联储：10月20日（周二）举办网络研讨会《讲授货币政策：从美联储起源到当今工具》，庆祝经济教育月。

text:
AI factories need to respond when the power grid needs relief.

At #OCPSummit26, NVIDIA’s Ian Buck explains how adjusting power use and shifting computing workloads can help, and why collaboration across the industry matters.
zh: 英伟达：OCP峰会上，英伟达Ian Buck称AI工厂要能在电网吃紧时响应，可通过调节用电、转移算力负载来缓解，并需全行业协作。

text:
Tesla shareholders: Our Annual Meeting is coming up on Dec 3rd

This year, we’re asking you to vote “FOR” all three proposals on the ballot, including the re-election of Elon Musk, Robyn Denholm and JB Straubel to Tesla’s Board.
zh: 特斯拉：股东年会定于12月3日举行，呼吁股东对三项议案全部投赞成票，包括马斯克、罗宾·丹霍姆和JB·斯特劳贝尔连任董事。

text:
I recently wrote about why we need to treat models as insider risks, with security controls sitting outside the model itself.

Today, we're putting that principle into practice by expanding Project Perception with new capabilities to help continuously assess agent risk, adapt
zh: 纳德拉（微软）：应把AI模型当作“内部风险”对待、在模型之外设安全管控；微软今天扩展Project Perception，新增持续评估AI智能体风险等能力。
黄仁勋：整个产业都将建立在开放模型之上，开发者需要自由去构建它们——保持模型开放可用至关重要。

text:
We're developing a service station for the Moon. 🌕

OASIS will provide power, communications and data services to scientific experiments, helping them survive the two-week lunar night and operate for years on the surface.
zh: 欧洲航天局：正在研制月球“服务站”OASIS，为月面科学实验提供电力、通信和数据服务，帮助其熬过两周的月夜并在月面运行多年。

text:
Next year, I will give one of my SpaceX shares to every kid in America.

This will be the first of many.
zh: 马斯克：明年我将把自己持有的SpaceX股票，给美国每个孩子各送一股。这只是开始。
